# Michael McNamara

> Personal site of Michael McNamara, an entrepreneur, photographer and systems thinker in Peterborough, New Hampshire. He works with people and organizations to bring what's out of tune into harmony.

## Key facts
- Name: Michael McNamara (full name Michael A. McNamara)
- Based in: Peterborough, New Hampshire
- Now: founder of ThisHouse Media, a real estate photography and media company in New Hampshire, Los Angeles and Austin; licensed real estate agent with eXp Realty in New Hampshire
- Background: 20 years in real estate media and technology; built ZenHouse Collective, a Los Angeles real estate media company behind 10,000+ property campaigns; co-founded ListingZen with computer scientist Artur Grigoryan; Creative Director of Lion & Orb; speaker at Sotheby's International conferences
- Writing: creation, growth and coherence in people, families and organizations
- Email: michaelamcnamara@gmail.com
